name: Carosino (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carosino (an eagle above a yellow bar and arrows on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Carosino, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Carosino arms — eagle above a yellow bar and arrows on blue, crowned, within branches
